reviewNotes:
Version 1.4 (build 29) improves Pro product loading and adds a customer-quote entry after a valid calculation. Nine app localizations are included: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Mexico), and French. Twelve App Store localizations are supplied.

Review the free flow: Calculate > Plate / flat bar > Make a customer quote > Create and add (or choose an existing project). After saving, tap Quote Preview. Free users can preview and share PDFs with SteelFlow branding, within the free project/item limits. View Project lets reviewers edit client information, prices, fees, margin and tax. No purchase is required for the free PDF.

Review Pro: in Quote Preview tap the Pro upgrade entry to see a clearly labelled branding example, localized App Store price, and purchase/restore actions. Pro adds company details/logo, removes SteelFlow branding, and unlocks CSV exports, local backups and unlimited projects/items. SteelFlow Pro is a non-consumable lifetime purchase (com.steelflow.app.pro.lifetime), not a subscription. Prices have not changed. Restore Purchases is also available in Settings.

Select the app language in Settings > App Language; PDF labels follow that selection. Seven PDF styles and A4/Letter paper are supported. No account is required. Calculations work offline. Project and quote content stays on the device; RevenueCat processes anonymous purchase and entitlement information.

pricing.note: Use territory-specific App Store price points; do not auto-convert from one base currency.
